answer_1.quote: The goal of dialog generation is to generate an informative and appropriate response given an input dialog...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the dialog generation performance of different models with BLEU, ROUGE, and unigram F1 score... we also use the KQA metric ... we evaluate the performance of the retriever with path@k metrics...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to assess the generated responses of our dialog generation model... We recruited 22 participants... We utilized a 3-point Likert-like scale to evaluate three criteria: Consistency, Informativeness, and Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated each generated response on a 3-point Likert scale for Consistency, Informativeness, and Fluency.
